name: torch-a11y
description: A small accessibility preferences panel for websites: text size, high contrast, reduced motion, highlighted links and a readable font. Applied before first paint, themed from your CSS variables, with an agent skill that prepares your codebase for it.

scripts.demo: bun run demo:pack && cd demo && bun run dev
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.demo:pack: bun run build && rm -rf demo/.pkg && mkdir -p demo/.pkg && npm pack --pack-destination demo/.pkg >/dev/null && cd demo && bun install && rm -rf node_modules/torch-a11y && mkdir -p node_modules/torch-a11y && tar -xzf .pkg/torch-a11y-*.tgz -C node_modules/torch-a11y --strip-components=1 && find node_modules/torch-a11y -exec touch {} +

author: Aswin Nair <aswintorch@gmail.com> (https://github.com/AswinTorch)
